senses.en: a skill developed through practice and study
senses.pattern: the art of conversation / the art of negotiation / master the art of
senses.example: It took the young reporter years to master the [[art]] of asking difficult questions politely.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕記者花了好幾年，才掌握禮貌地提出尖銳問題的技巧。

senses.en: subjects such as languages, history, and literature
senses.pattern: the arts and sciences / an arts student / a Bachelor of Arts
senses.example: She chose the sciences in senior high, while her twin brother preferred the [[arts]], especially history and literature.
senses.example_zh: 她高中選了理科，而她的雙胞胎哥哥偏好文科，尤其是歷史和文學。

gsat.sentence: But the culinary [[art]] of dim sum had yet to develop, for it was considered inappropriate to pair tea with food.
Despite the threats posed by cultural and political encroachment of colonial forces, the [[art]] of totem pole carving has survived.

senses.en: to face danger or bad conditions with courage
senses.pattern: brave the storm / brave the cold / brave the crowds / brave the elements
senses.example: Hundreds of fans [[braved]] the heavy rain to watch the school band's final outdoor concert.
senses.example_zh: 數百名樂迷冒著大雨，觀賞學校樂隊的最後一場戶外音樂會。

senses.en: a fault in a computer program or system
senses.pattern: a software bug / fix a bug / a bug in the system
senses.example: The game kept crashing until the developers found and fixed a [[bug]] in the code.
senses.example_zh: 這款遊戲一直當機，直到開發人員找到並修正程式碼裡的一個錯誤。

senses.en: to annoy or keep bothering someone
senses.pattern: stop bugging me / bug somebody about something / it bugs me that
senses.example: My little brother keeps [[bugging]] me to play with him while I am trying to study.
senses.example_zh: 我想讀書的時候，弟弟卻一直來煩我，要我陪他玩。

senses.en: careful and thorough
senses.pattern: pay close attention to / take a close look / on closer examination / keep a close watch on
senses.example: The doctor took a [[close]] look at the X-ray before deciding whether surgery was necessary.
senses.example_zh: 醫生仔細看過 X 光片後，才決定是否需要動手術。

senses.en: (of a contest) won or lost by a small amount
senses.pattern: a close game / a close race / a close contest / too close to call
senses.example: It was such a [[close]] game that the winner was not decided until the final second.
senses.example_zh: 那場比賽勢均力敵，直到最後一秒才分出勝負。

senses.en: the end of a period or activity
senses.pattern: at the close of / come to a close / draw to a close / bring sth to a close
senses.example: As the school year drew to a [[close]], the seniors began cleaning out their lockers.
senses.example_zh: 學年即將結束之際，高三生開始清空自己的置物櫃。

gsat.sentence: Upon [[closer]] examination, de Mestral observed that the burrs, which appeared straight to the naked eye, actually contained many small hooks that clung firmly to the loops in the fabric of his pants.
At the [[close]] of the 15th century, Europeans’ craze for spices gave rise to the Spice Route, a network of sea lanes joining Europe with the Far East, where most spices came from.

senses.en: to be sold or available in a particular form
senses.pattern: come in three sizes / come in many colors / come with a warranty
senses.example: These running shoes [[come]] in five colors, but only the black pair is available in my size.
senses.example_zh: 這款跑鞋有五種顏色可選，但只有黑色那雙有我的尺寸。

senses.en: to gradually begin to think or feel something
senses.pattern: come to realize / come to believe / come to be known as
senses.example: After living abroad for a year, Mia [[came]] to appreciate the small comforts of her hometown.
senses.example_zh: 在國外住了一年後，米亞逐漸懂得珍惜家鄉那些小小的舒適。
senses.note: come to 後接原形動詞

gsat.sentence: Today, spiral staircases [[come]] in a wide variety of materials: steel, wood, concrete, and recently even glass.
We have [[come]] to believe that storytelling is just for children.

senses.en: an illness or medical problem, often not serious
senses.pattern: a skin complaint / a stomach complaint / a minor complaint
senses.example: The cream is used to treat eczema and other common skin [[complaints]] in young children.
senses.example_zh: 這種藥膏用於治療幼兒的濕疹及其他常見的皮膚疾病。

gsat.sentence: He frequently ordered blood tests and X-rays, and repeatedly referred her to specialists for even minor [[complaints]].
Most physician office visits are for stress-related illnesses and [[complaints]].

senses.en: to frighten someone into doing what you want
senses.pattern: be cowed by / be cowed into silence / refuse to be cowed
senses.example: The villagers refused to be [[cowed]] by the threats and kept protesting against the polluting factory.
senses.example_zh: 面對種種威脅，村民不受威嚇，持續抗議那家製造污染的工廠。

senses.en: to attract people or their attention or interest
senses.pattern: draw a crowd / draw attention to / be drawn to
senses.example: The night market [[draws]] thousands of tourists every weekend with its cheap and tasty snacks.
senses.example_zh: 這個夜市以便宜又美味的小吃，每個週末吸引數千名觀光客。
senses.note: 名詞 draw 另指「平手；抽籤」

senses.en: to reach a conclusion or idea after thinking
senses.pattern: draw a conclusion / draw a lesson from / draw a comparison
senses.example: It is too early to [[draw]] any conclusions from a survey of only twenty people.
senses.example_zh: 只調查了二十個人，現在要得出任何結論還太早。

gsat.sentence: People may choose a name because they are strongly [[drawn]] to a character in a book or a television series; they may also adopt names of famous people or their favorite actors and actresses.
What is the most significant implication that teachers can [[draw]] from the above information? They should

senses.en: something that makes an important thing happen or grow
senses.pattern: a key driver of growth / the main driver of / a driver of change
senses.example: Tourism has been the main [[driver]] of economic growth on the island for two decades.
senses.example_zh: 二十年來，觀光業一直是島上經濟成長的主要推手。

senses.en: software that controls a piece of computer equipment
senses.pattern: install a driver / update the driver / a printer driver
senses.example: The printer would not work until I installed the latest [[driver]] on my laptop.
senses.example_zh: 直到我在筆電上安裝了最新的驅動程式，印表機才能運作。

senses.en: an ability to recognize and copy sounds well
senses.pattern: have an ear for music / a good ear for languages / play by ear
senses.example: With a good [[ear]] for languages, Mia picked up Spanish after only a few months in Madrid.
senses.example_zh: 米雅對語言的辨音力很好，在馬德里才待幾個月就學會了西班牙語。

senses.en: the top part of a grain plant containing seeds
senses.pattern: an ear of corn / ears of wheat / ears of rice
senses.example: The farmer picked a ripe [[ear]] of corn and roasted it over the fire for us.
senses.example_zh: 農夫摘下一根成熟的玉米穗，放在火上烤給我們吃。

senses.en: to make a hidden crime or dishonest act public
senses.pattern: expose a scandal / expose corruption / expose a fraud / expose the truth
senses.example: The young reporter [[exposed]] a factory that had been secretly dumping waste into the river.
senses.example_zh: 這名年輕記者揭發了一家偷偷把廢棄物排入河中的工廠。

senses.en: to give someone the chance to experience something new
senses.pattern: expose students to new ideas / expose children to music / be exposed to a language
senses.example: The exchange program [[exposes]] students to different cultures and ways of thinking.
senses.example_zh: 這項交換計畫讓學生接觸不同的文化與思考方式。
senses.note: 常用被動 be exposed to；名詞 exposure

gsat.sentence: The more one is [[exposed]] to the English-speaking environment, the better he or she will learn the language.
But it’s the parents’ job to serve a variety of foods and [[expose]] their children to healthy dieting habits.

senses.en: to let someone down when they need you
senses.pattern: fail one's family / never fail a friend / words fail me
senses.example: He felt he had [[failed]] his teammates by missing the final shot of the game.
senses.example_zh: 他覺得自己沒投進比賽的最後一球，辜負了隊友。

senses.en: to become weak or stop working properly
senses.pattern: failing eyesight / failing health / the brakes failed / the engine failed
senses.example: Although her eyesight is [[failing]], my great-aunt still enjoys listening to audiobooks every evening.
senses.example_zh: 雖然姑婆的視力日漸衰退，她每天晚上仍然喜歡聽有聲書。

senses.en: firmly and tightly; (asleep) deeply
senses.pattern: fast asleep / hold fast to / be stuck fast
senses.example: The baby was [[fast]] asleep in her mother's arms despite the noise of the crowded station.
senses.example_zh: 儘管擁擠的車站很吵，寶寶仍在媽媽懷裡睡得很熟。

senses.en: to eat no food for a period of time
senses.pattern: fast for twelve hours / fast before a blood test / fast during the holy month
senses.example: Patients are usually asked to [[fast]] for eight hours before this kind of blood test.
senses.example_zh: 做這種抽血檢查前，病人通常被要求禁食八小時。
senses.note: 亦作名詞；breakfast 原指「打破禁食」

senses.en: an attempt at something; a turn in a game
senses.pattern: have a go (at) / give it a go / in one go / It's your go.
senses.example: I had never tried surfing before, but my cousin persuaded me to have a [[go]].
senses.example_zh: 我從沒試過衝浪，但表哥說服我嘗試一下。
senses.note: 複數 goes；in one go 一口氣

senses.en: to become, especially in a bad way
senses.pattern: go bad / go blind / go bankrupt / go wrong
senses.example: Milk left out of the refrigerator on a hot day will [[go]] sour within hours.
senses.example_zh: 大熱天沒放進冰箱的牛奶，幾小時內就會變酸。

senses.en: (of a saying, story, or song) to have certain words
senses.pattern: as the saying goes / the story goes that / how does the song go
senses.example: As the old saying [[goes]], a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
senses.example_zh: 俗話說得好，千里之行，始於足下。

gsat.sentence: Also, drinking a lot of liquid in one [[go]] can cause more water to pass through the body quickly and come out as urine.
In fact, there is a well-known Russian proverb that [[goes]], “Smiling with no reason is a sign of stupidity.”

senses.en: young and lacking experience
senses.pattern: still green / a green recruit / too green for the job
senses.example: The coach knew the players were still [[green]], so he arranged extra practice games for them.
senses.example_zh: 教練知道這些球員還很生嫩，所以替他們多安排了幾場練習賽。

senses.en: not harmful to the environment
senses.pattern: green energy / green products / go green / green buildings
senses.example: The school went [[green]] by installing solar panels and banning plastic bottles on campus.
senses.example_zh: 這所學校裝設太陽能板並禁止校園內使用塑膠瓶，走向環保。

gsat.sentence: Greatly concerned about the presence of fake “[[green]]” products on the market, Alice Bao decided to open this shop.
Then, a local [[green]] energy startup company got the idea to turn that waste into energy.

senses.en: the point when something is at its strongest or busiest
senses.pattern: at the height of / the height of summer / at its height / the height of one's career
senses.example: At the [[height]] of the tourist season, the small island receives ten thousand visitors a day.
senses.example_zh: 在旅遊旺季的高峰，這座小島每天有一萬名遊客到訪。

senses.en: a high place or position
senses.pattern: a fear of heights / be afraid of heights / fall from a height
senses.example: My brother is so afraid of [[heights]] that he refuses to ride the Ferris wheel.
senses.example_zh: 我弟弟非常害怕高處，連摩天輪都不肯搭。
senses.note: 常用複數；reach new heights 再創高峰

gsat.sentence: In this line of work, the person is paid to do daring actions that are deemed too risky for the regular actor to perform, including jumping from [[heights]], crashing cars, or fighting with weapons.

senses.en: to affect a person or place very badly
senses.pattern: be hit by / be hard hit / be badly hit
senses.example: The small fishing village was badly [[hit]] by the storm, and dozens of boats were destroyed.
senses.example_zh: 這個小漁村遭暴風雨重創，數十艘船被毀。

senses.en: to reach a particular level or number
senses.pattern: hit a record high / hit a new low / hit 40 degrees
senses.example: Temperatures in the desert city [[hit]] 45 degrees last week, the highest level in a century.
senses.example_zh: 這座沙漠城市的氣溫上週達到四十五度，是百年來的最高紀錄。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following is a reason why Dallas was [[hit]] most seriously in the U.S. in 2012?
The island continues to recover from its 1992 visit from Iniki, the most powerful hurricane to [[hit]] Hawaii this century.

senses.en: to provide a place for people or things
senses.pattern: house refugees / house a collection / be housed in
senses.example: The gym was turned into a shelter to [[house]] families who had lost their homes in the flood.
senses.example_zh: 體育館被改成避難所，收容在水災中失去家園的家庭。

senses.en: a company in a particular business, such as publishing
senses.pattern: a publishing house / a fashion house / an auction house
senses.example: Her first novel was turned down by five publishing [[houses]] before it finally became a bestseller.
senses.example_zh: 她的第一本小說被五家出版公司退稿，最後才成為暢銷書。

gsat.sentence: The booth he built [[housed]] only an old dial phone with a disconnected phone line.

senses.en: to make something unpleasant more likely to happen
senses.pattern: invite trouble / invite criticism / invite disaster / invite danger
senses.example: Posting your home address online is [[inviting]] trouble, so think twice before you share it.
senses.example_zh: 在網路上公開住家地址等於是招惹麻煩，分享之前務必三思。

senses.en: to formally ask for comments, questions, or applications
senses.pattern: invite questions / invite comments / invite applications / invite suggestions
senses.example: The city government is [[inviting]] suggestions from residents on how to redesign the riverside park.
senses.example_zh: 市政府正在向居民徵求重新設計河濱公園的建議。

gsat.sentence: To bring the evil eye into the home is thus believed to [[invite]] trouble and sorrow.

senses.en: very; extremely (formal)
senses.pattern: most grateful / a most interesting talk / most kind of you
senses.example: It was a [[most]] enjoyable evening, and we thanked our hosts warmly before leaving.
senses.example_zh: 那是個非常愉快的夜晚，我們離開前熱情地向主人道謝。
senses.note: 前面用 a 或不加冠詞，不表最高級

gsat.sentence: I’m [[most]] terribly sorry, Mr. Hagen.

senses.en: something that you must have, see, or do
senses.pattern: a must for / an absolute must / a must-see
senses.example: Comfortable shoes are a [[must]] if you plan to walk around the old town all day.
senses.example_zh: 如果你打算整天在老城區走動，一雙舒適的鞋子是必備之物。

senses.en: a state in which laws and rules are obeyed
senses.pattern: law and order / keep order / restore order / maintain public order
senses.example: Extra police officers were sent to keep [[order]] outside the stadium after the final match.
senses.example_zh: 決賽結束後，警方加派人手到體育場外維持秩序。

senses.en: a request for goods to be made or supplied
senses.pattern: place an order / cancel an order / receive an order for
senses.example: The factory received a large [[order]] for bicycle parts from a company in Germany.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠接到一家德國公司的大筆自行車零件訂單。

senses.en: to start a fight or argument on purpose
senses.pattern: pick a fight with sb / pick a quarrel / pick an argument
senses.example: He was in a bad mood and tried to [[pick]] a fight with his brother.
senses.example_zh: 他心情不好，還想故意跟弟弟挑起爭吵。

senses.en: to open a lock without a key
senses.pattern: pick a lock / pick the lock on a door
senses.example: The thief [[picked]] the lock on the back door and entered the house quietly.
senses.example_zh: 小偷撬開後門的鎖，悄悄進入屋內。

senses.en: to hold someone or something so it cannot move
senses.pattern: pin sb to the ground / be pinned under / pin sb against the wall
senses.example: The wrestler [[pinned]] his opponent to the mat for three seconds and won the gold medal.
senses.example_zh: 這位摔角選手把對手壓在墊上三秒，使他動彈不得，贏得金牌。

senses.en: to depend on something completely for hope or success
senses.pattern: pin one's hopes on / pin one's faith on / pin everything on
senses.example: The villagers have [[pinned]] their hopes on the new bridge to bring more visitors to the area.
senses.example_zh: 村民把希望寄託於這座新橋，期盼它為當地帶來更多遊客。
senses.note: pin the blame on＝把過錯歸咎於

senses.en: a usual or customary way of doing something
senses.pattern: a common practice / standard practice / the practice of tipping / religious practices
senses.example: The [[practice]] of giving children red envelopes at Lunar New Year goes back hundreds of years.
senses.example_zh: 農曆新年給小孩紅包的習俗已有數百年的歷史。

senses.en: the work or business of a doctor or lawyer
senses.pattern: medical practice / a law practice / private practice / the practice of medicine
senses.example: After ten years at a city hospital, Dr. Sato opened her own dental [[practice]] in her hometown.
senses.example_zh: 在市立醫院服務十年後，佐藤醫師在家鄉開設了自己的牙科診所。

gsat.sentence: In 1979, however, male names were also included because women protested against the original naming [[practice]] for reasons of gender equality.
Jonathan had qualified as a doctor but later gave up the [[practice]] of medicine for full-time writing.

senses.en: to declare something officially or formally
senses.pattern: pronounce sb dead / pronounce sb fit / pronounce sb husband and wife
senses.example: After a careful examination, the vet [[pronounced]] the injured eagle healthy enough to be released.
senses.example_zh: 仔細檢查後，獸醫宣布這隻受傷的老鷹已經健康到可以野放了。

senses.en: very noticeable or obvious
senses.pattern: a pronounced effect / a pronounced difference / become more pronounced
senses.example: The difference between the two groups was most [[pronounced]] among students who slept under six hours.
senses.example_zh: 兩組之間的差異，在睡眠不足六小時的學生當中最為顯著。
senses.note: 由過去分詞轉成的形容詞 pronounced

gsat.sentence: Early this past summer the three whales were [[pronounced]] fit enough to be returned to the Atlantic Ocean.

senses.en: the main cause or origin of a problem
senses.pattern: the root of the problem / the root cause / get to the root of / lie at the root of
senses.example: Poor communication, not a lack of money, lies at the [[root]] of the team's problems.
senses.example_zh: 這個團隊問題的根源在於溝通不良，而不是缺錢。
senses.note: 複數 roots 可指「祖籍、出身」

senses.en: to support or cheer for a person or team
senses.pattern: root for the home team / root for someone / root for the underdog
senses.example: The whole class came to the final to [[root]] for our school's basketball team.
senses.example_zh: 全班都來到決賽現場，為我們學校的籃球隊加油。
senses.note: 美式口語，固定搭配 root for

gsat.sentence: Jack: I wish I were a millionaire. I could buy whatever I want. Jane: Well, it may be true. But we must bear in mind that the love of money is also the [[root]] of all evil.

senses.en: one stage in a series of events or a competition
senses.pattern: a round of talks / the first round / a round of applause
senses.example: Our debate team was knocked out in the second [[round]] of the national tournament.
senses.example_zh: 我們的辯論隊在全國錦標賽的第二輪就被淘汰了。
senses.note: a round of applause 一陣掌聲

senses.en: to go around a corner or bend
senses.pattern: round the corner / round a bend / round the final turn
senses.example: As the bus [[rounded]] the corner, we caught our first sight of the sea.
senses.example_zh: 公車繞過轉角時，我們第一次瞥見了大海。

gsat.sentence: This in turn enriched subsequent [[rounds]] of conversation.

senses.en: to make an official decision, especially in court
senses.pattern: rule that / rule in favor of / rule against / rule on a case
senses.example: The judge [[ruled]] that the factory must pay for cleaning up the polluted river.
senses.example_zh: 法官裁定該工廠必須支付清理受污染河川的費用。

senses.en: to decide that something is not possible
senses.pattern: rule out the possibility / rule out a cause / cannot be ruled out
senses.example: Police have not [[ruled]] out the possibility that the fire was started on purpose.
senses.example_zh: 警方尚未排除有人蓄意縱火的可能性。

gsat.sentence: If a serious injury is [[ruled]] out and the pain is not getting worse after exercising, then the exercise “makes a lot of sense.”

senses.en: a large group of fish swimming together
senses.pattern: a school of fish / a school of dolphins / swim in schools
senses.example: While diving near the island, we saw a huge [[school]] of silver fish swim past.
senses.example_zh: 我們在島嶼附近潛水時，看見一大群銀色的魚游過。

senses.en: a group of thinkers or artists with similar ideas
senses.pattern: a school of thought / the Impressionist school / two schools of thought
senses.example: There are two [[schools]] of thought about whether homework really helps young children learn.
senses.example_zh: 關於作業是否真的有助於幼童學習，有兩派不同的看法。

senses.en: fixed in advance and not changing
senses.pattern: a set time / a set price / a set menu / set rules
senses.example: There is no [[set]] time for dinner in our house; we eat whenever everyone gets home.
senses.example_zh: 我們家沒有固定的晚餐時間，大家都到家了就開飯。

senses.en: to become solid or firm
senses.pattern: leave the jelly to set / wait for the glue to set / the concrete sets / set hard
senses.example: Put the pudding in the fridge for two hours and wait for it to [[set]].
senses.example_zh: 把布丁放進冰箱兩小時，等它凝固。

senses.en: the scenery or place used for a play or film
senses.pattern: on the set / a film set / a stage set / build the set
senses.example: The actors stayed on the [[set]] until midnight to finish shooting the final scene.
senses.example_zh: 演員們在片場待到午夜，才拍完最後一場戲。

senses.en: one of the equal parts a company is divided into
senses.pattern: buy shares / sell shares / share prices / shares in a company
senses.example: He bought a few [[shares]] in the bicycle company when it was still small and unknown.
senses.example_zh: 那家自行車公司還規模很小、沒沒無聞時，他就買了一些股份。

senses.en: one person's part of something divided among several people
senses.pattern: do one's share / a fair share of / market share / one's share of the blame
senses.example: If everyone does their [[share]] of the housework, the apartment will stay clean and tidy.
senses.example_zh: 如果每個人都做好自己應分擔的那一份家事，公寓就能保持乾淨整齊。

gsat.sentence: He realizes that only by cooperating can he do his [[share]] in making society what it should be.
Although about 90 percent of American households still use film cameras, digital cameras are capturing a growing [[share]] of the consumer market.

senses.en: a set of facts or numbers arranged in rows
senses.pattern: a table of contents / the table below / a multiplication table / see Table 2
senses.example: The [[table]] on page ten shows how much sugar each popular drink contains.
senses.example_zh: 第十頁的表格列出每種熱門飲料的含糖量。

senses.en: to delay discussing a proposal until later
senses.pattern: table a proposal / table a motion / table a bill / table the discussion
senses.example: Short of time, the student council [[tabled]] the proposal and agreed to discuss it next month.
senses.example_zh: 由於時間不夠，學生會擱置了這項提案，並同意下個月再討論。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式則指「提出討論」

gsat.sentence: When I open a book, I look first at the [[table]] of contents to get a general idea of the book and to see which chapters I might be interested in reading.
I remember that on my cruise I was required to formally plot our course, using the tide [[table]], even though our goal was an island I could see quite clearly across the water in the distance.

senses.en: a liking or preference for something
senses.pattern: a taste for adventure / develop a taste for / suit all tastes / musical tastes
senses.example: Over the years, Dad has developed a [[taste]] for jazz and now collects old records.
senses.example_zh: 這些年來，爸爸漸漸養成對爵士樂的愛好，現在還收藏老唱片。

senses.en: the ability to judge what is beautiful or suitable
senses.pattern: have good taste / in bad taste / taste in clothes / a person of taste
senses.example: Everyone praises her [[taste]] in clothes, yet she rarely buys anything expensive.
senses.example_zh: 大家都稱讚她的穿衣品味，但她很少買昂貴的東西。

senses.en: a short first experience of something
senses.pattern: a taste of freedom / a first taste of success / get a taste of
senses.example: The summer camp gave the students their first [[taste]] of life away from home.
senses.example_zh: 這次夏令營讓學生們初次體驗離家生活的滋味。
senses.note: 常用 a taste of＋名詞

gsat.sentence: The fortune cookie was based on a Japanese snack, but Hagiwara sweetened the recipe to appeal to American [[tastes]].
The fragrances at this scent shop are largely customized to meet the individual shopper’s [[taste]].

senses.en: the flat part on each side of the forehead
senses.pattern: rub one's temples / a pain in the temples / gray hair at the temples
senses.example: The nurse placed a cool towel on the boy's forehead and [[temples]] to bring his fever down.
senses.example_zh: 護士把涼毛巾敷在男孩的額頭和太陽穴上，幫他退燒。

senses.en: in the process of; being affected by
senses.pattern: under construction / under discussion / under investigation / under pressure
senses.example: The new metro line is still [[under]] construction and will not open until next spring.
senses.example_zh: 新的捷運線仍在興建中，要到明年春天才會通車。

senses.en: according to a law, rule, or agreement
senses.pattern: under the law / under the new rules / under the terms of / under the agreement
senses.example: [[Under]] the new rules, students may not use their phones during class without permission.
senses.example_zh: 根據新規定，學生未經許可不得在上課時使用手機。

senses.en: led, ruled, or managed by someone
senses.pattern: under the leadership of / under the guidance of / under the rule of / under new management
senses.example: The choir improved quickly [[under]] the guidance of a conductor who had trained in Vienna.
senses.example_zh: 在一位曾於維也納受訓的指揮指導下，合唱團進步神速。

gsat.sentence: When watching a frightening film, people are in the comfort of their own home or theater seats rather than [[under]] the threat of any real danger.
[[Under]] the guidance of 100% Fish, however, Icelanders are now using almost 95% of a cod.

senses.en: a sudden increase in an activity or feeling
senses.pattern: a wave of protests / a heat wave / a crime wave / a wave of panic
senses.example: The singer's surprise retirement set off a [[wave]] of sadness among fans around the world.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手無預警引退，在全球歌迷間掀起一波哀傷的情緒。

gsat.sentence: In response to rising demands, these hotels are embracing a [[wave]] of innovation. Instead of the traditional bare pod-sized style, new chains now feature interior design that appeals to digitally connected travelers from around the world.

senses.en: by a large amount or distance; far
senses.pattern: way too much / way ahead / way behind / way more
senses.example: Ticket prices this year are [[way]] higher than last year, so fewer families are going to the festival.
senses.example_zh: 今年的票價遠遠高於去年，所以去參加慶典的家庭變少了。

senses.en: a particular aspect or point of something
senses.pattern: in many ways / in some ways / in every way
senses.example: In many [[ways]], life in a small town is healthier than life in a crowded city.
senses.example_zh: 在許多方面，小鎮的生活比擁擠城市的生活更健康。

senses.en: to damage or use up through long use
senses.pattern: wear thin / wear a hole in / wear away / wear out
senses.example: Centuries of footsteps have [[worn]] the temple's stone steps smooth and slightly hollow in the middle.
senses.example_zh: 數百年來的腳步把寺廟的石階磨損得光滑，中間還微微凹陷。
senses.note: worn out 也指「筋疲力盡的」

senses.en: to have a particular expression on your face
senses.pattern: wear a smile / wear a frown / wear a puzzled look / wear a serious expression
senses.example: The exchange student [[wore]] a puzzled look when the teacher began speaking in the local dialect.
senses.example_zh: 當老師開始說起當地方言時，那名交換學生面帶困惑的表情。

gsat.sentence: Kim was completely [[worn]] out after jogging in the hot sun all afternoon; she had little energy left.

senses.en: although; despite the fact that
senses.pattern: While it is true that / While I agree that
senses.example: [[While]] I understand your worries, I still believe the school trip is safe enough for everyone.
senses.example_zh: 雖然我理解你的擔憂，我仍然相信這趟校外教學對大家來說夠安全。
senses.note: 此義的 while 子句多置於句首

senses.en: used to contrast two different facts or situations
senses.pattern: some…, while others… / A is…, while B is…
senses.example: My brother spends his allowance as soon as he gets it, [[while]] I save most of mine.
senses.example_zh: 我哥哥零用錢一拿到就花光，而我則把大部分存起來。

gsat.sentence: [[While]] this oil-absorbing feature might not always be so great for our hygiene, it can be great for the environment.
The straps on the heel and toe control the length of the shoe, [[while]] the two on either side allow for different widths.

quiz.stem: After the earthquake, rescuers worked for six hours to free a man whose legs were ______ under a fallen concrete wall.
quiz.explain_zh: pin＝壓住、使動彈不得。男子雙腿被倒塌的水泥牆壓住，救難人員花六小時才救出他。

quiz.stem: Although the temperature had dropped below zero, dozens of volunteers ______ the cold to deliver hot meals to elderly people living alone.
quiz.explain_zh: brave＝勇敢面對、冒著。志工冒著嚴寒為獨居長者送熱食。

quiz.stem: Whenever she has a bad headache, Ms. Wu closes her eyes and gently massages her ______ with her fingertips until the pain eases.
quiz.explain_zh: temple＝太陽穴。吳女士頭痛時會閉上眼睛，用指尖按摩太陽穴。

quiz.stem: ______ the new ticketing app is quick and easy to use, many elderly passengers still prefer to buy their train tickets at the counter.
quiz.explain_zh: while＝雖然。雖然購票程式好用，許多年長乘客仍偏好臨櫃買票。

quiz.stem: In many Asian countries, it is a common ______ to remove your shoes before entering a home, so guests should remember to wear clean socks.
quiz.explain_zh: practice＝慣例、習俗。進門前脫鞋在許多亞洲國家是普遍的習俗。

quiz.stem: The cause of the factory fire is still ______ investigation, and the police have not yet said when the results will be announced.
quiz.explain_zh: under＝在…（進行）中。工廠火災的起因仍在調查中，警方尚未公布結果。

quiz.stem: The doctor said that my grandfather's stomach ______ was not serious and could be treated with a change of diet and some rest.
quiz.explain_zh: complaint＝疾病、身體不適。爺爺的胃病不嚴重，調整飲食並休息即可治療。

quiz.stem: After the earthquake damaged their dormitory, the 120 students were temporarily ______ in a nearby hotel until the repairs were finished.
quiz.explain_zh: house＝收容、安置。宿舍受損後，學生暫時被安置在附近的旅館。

quiz.stem: At the ______ of the flu season, the hospital's emergency room was so crowded that some patients waited for hours in the hallway.
quiz.explain_zh: height＝頂點、高峰。流感季高峰時，急診室擠到病人得在走廊等。

quiz.stem: Having joined the newspaper only a month ago, the young reporter was still ______ and often needed advice from senior colleagues on how to conduct interviews.
quiz.explain_zh: green＝無經驗的、生嫩的。記者才入行一個月，採訪還常需前輩指點。
